exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 213 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution), not just today's window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 213 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A handful of contacts carry more than one lead: tag, so counts don't sum exactly to 213 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the same 121-opportunity bulk-import batch (frozen since the Oct 2025 pipeline launch) and a handful of 200+ day Postponed records. '2. *Project Won* ' has 0 currently-open records (won opportunities move out of 'open' status).
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Continues the documented ~297 won / ~1,132 abandoned scale from 07-25, growing steadily run over run.
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 50 open (6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned, lifetime). Retail material sales, distinct from project work. 13 of the 50 'open' records actually sit in stage '6a. Closed - Won' and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost' — the opportunity status field was never flipped, a platform data-quality quirk, not new activity. No stale thresholds defined for this pipeline (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence).

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.note: 6 of 21 Meeting-Scheduled contacts had a verifiable appointment date this run (calendar lookback only covers ~14 days back / 90 days forward, so old appointments like Bash Saqr's and Tina Tran's fall outside it — same limitation noted 08-08/08-14). Basil Felix Da Souza's window is deeply negative (appointment happened 58 days after stage entry, effective_window_days ~ -28) — appointment booked far past the point the stage would already read stale, a workflow-timing bug. Glendy Chang and Jonathan Spence show the opposite anomaly: stage entry came AFTER their appointment date (both repeat customers whose opportunity was created/re-opened post-visit), which doesn't shrink the window.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to today's 26 active conversations and their mobile-quote-tagged contacts (Ritesh Dewan, Gustavo Galvis, Kevin, Piyush Aggarwal, Mellisa Fonte, Sabrina Agard, Sowmya, and others); no violations found — all had outbound activity (automated nurture counts) within the 5-day quote_followup_days window. A full account-wide sweep was not attempted this run (same scoping limitation as prior runs).

drift_findings_breakdown._comment: metrics.drift_findings is the sum of underlying affected records per category (after the 0a. New Lead exclusion), not the count of report lines in workflow_drift (which aggregates large groups into single lines for readability).

reporting.resolved_since_last_report: Giovanni Zapata, flagged as abandonment_next on 08-14 (58.8 days, 165% of 2x threshold), auto-abandoned today — the automation does eventually catch up. That leaves 4 of the original 5 08-14 abandonment_next candidates still open.
reporting.platform_note_candidate_1: Two 0a. New Lead opportunities (Avi Maheshwari, Quel Molina) auto-abandoned today at 7 and 15 days respectively — both earlier than the documented 14-day stale / 28-day abandon thresholds for this stage. Both being same-day suggests a real discrepancy between the live automation and platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json, not a one-off; worth confirming with Albert.
reporting.platform_note_candidate_2: The tag 'abandoned-stale' persists on Bash Saqr and Tina Tran (both Meeting-Scheduled, 96-101 days, status open) — flagged 08-14 and still unresolved. Not in the documented GHL tag vocabulary; worth confirming whether it's an informal Albert marker or an automation output.
reporting.ingest_gap_note: The last successful ghl-ingest run before this one was 2026-08-14 (a 1-day gap: 2026-08-15 was not ingested). Per instructions this run used the standard 24h window (2026-08-15T08:19 to 2026-08-16T08:19 America/Toronto) rather than backfilling the gap; some 08-15 activity surfaces indirectly (e.g. Sabrina Agard's win, dated 08-15T17:48, fell inside this run's 24h window and is captured normally).
